Re-author 702.5 on a black-border Aura, e.g. Rancor (9d2d6479-531c-4ce1-b52b-00e36fa63b64) ruling 2018-03-16 (an Aura spell whose target is illegal doesn't resolve and never enters) or Spreading Seas (af32757c-9d3c-4f6c-a6fa-d5729a440382) ruling 2009-10-01; keep 702.5a.

question: Can Animate Library enchant my Contraption deck?

expected.shortAnswer: No: Animate Library cannot enchant your Contraption deck.
expected.answer: Animate Library can't enchant your Contraption deck.
